visualCharacteristics.structure: large pull quote, no border, light-weight large type, attribution below indented with leading em dash
visualCharacteristics.source: source: 36px light (300) dark text, 40px vertical margins, 16px attribution indented 20px with em dash
visualCharacteristics.purpose: large display pull quote in news and story articles

contentPattern.structure: row 1 is the quotation (one or more paragraphs, a single Quotation richtext field); row 2 is the optional attribution (plain text name and role, Attribution field; the leading em dash is added by CSS)

reuseGuidance: Use for the standard large pull quote in news and story articles (also seen on annabelle-shares, reimagining-your-life, shine-magazine stories). Use quote-bordered for inline statement quotes with a grey left rule.
